business_summary: Shenzhen Forms Syntron Information Co.,Ltd. offers fintech software development services, consulting services, and system integration services across China and Hong Kong. Its fintech software development segment offers integrated software systems and services to banks for personal finance, corporate finance and banking, digital banking channel solutions, mobile and branch touchpoints, and banking operations and data service; and financial infrastructure and fintech innovation services: financial infrastructure services for payment and settlement systems, and fintech innovation services to design and deploy digital financial systems. It offers services by time-and-material model and project-based contract model. Its consulting services segment offers fintech strategy, architecture and implementation services: solution blueprints, feasibility studies, and proofs-of-concept. Its system integration services segment offers implementation: procurement management, hardware acquisition, third-party software licensing, installation, integration and testing. Its FINNOSafe Web3 platform deliver tokenization infrastructure for regulated tokenized money and real-world assets. It also offers Blockchain Valley@Cyberport, a co-creation centre to aggregate innovation, talent, and capital. Its ongoing projects include FINNOSmart for talent management; Blockchain-Based Trusted Data Exchange Platform; and Digital Collaborative Office System. It serves financial institutions, including commercial and specialized banks, non-banking financial institutions, such as technology service providers and financial technology solution firms. Shenzhen Forms Syntron Information Co.,Ltd. was formerly known as Forms Syntron Information (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd and changed its name to Shenzhen Forms Syntron Information Co.,Ltd. in February 2012. The company was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China with an additional office in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong.
